title: Implicit Toxicity Detection in Bangla-English Code-Mixed Text
problem: Implicit toxicity is difficult to detect in noisy, low-resource Bangla-English conversations where harmful meaning depends on context.
approach: Built a context-aware transformer model for implicit toxicity detection
Created a preprocessing pipeline for noisy code-mixed text

title: ECG Anomaly Detection & Health Monitoring
problem: Automate arrhythmia detection from MIT-BIH ECG recordings for real-time health monitoring.
approach: Combined Random Forest and LSTM models
Implemented preprocessing, R-peak detection, and morphological feature extraction

title: Real-Time Drowsiness Detection System
problem: Detect visual signs of driver drowsiness in real time on resource-constrained hardware.
approach: Tracked Eye and Mouth Aspect Ratios (EAR/MAR)
Optimized on-device inference with adaptive thresholding

title: Green AI Inference: Carbon-Aware Model Switching
problem: Reduce the carbon cost of inference without making model selection unstable.
approach: Designed dynamic model switching that balances efficiency and stability during inference

title: Voice Feature Extraction & Stress Detection

approach: Extracted pitch, volume, and speech-rate features
Trained an ML classifier on the derived voice features

title: Sentiment Detection System

approach: Built a text preprocessing and feature-extraction pipeline

title: Academic Integrity Monitoring System
problem: Surface suspicious behavior during online assessments while preserving useful evidence for later review.
approach: Tracked activity and detected behavioral anomalies in real time
